verdict.rationale: The product is an iPhone app paired with an ESP32 board, and tasks are run through the app UI, Siri, Shortcuts, widgets or Control Center. A CLI is a fair axis for this kind of product, but the evidence documents no official CLI for driving the agent. The only command-line items are a firmware build script (flash.sh) and a BLE debugging script (board_test.py). These are developer and debugging tooling, adjacent to the story rather than a user-facing CLI, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
